Team —

We need a tight pass on true commits for the next 48 hours. Quick ask/plan below: 

1) Stage locks: please set any deal you expect to close with >75% confidence to "Commit - Legal OK" (or "Commit - Finance OK" where appropriate) in HubSpot. Only deals with final PO/LOI or contract in its last redline should be marked commit.

2) Numbers: update the attached snapshot (Q4_pipeline_snapshot_v2.xlsx) with the final ARR and close date. If you change a deal amount, add a one-line rationale in the comment column.

3) Flags: if procurement or legal still needs to sign off, add a comment and tag @finance_ops (finops@acmehealth.com) so we can surface to FP&A.

4) Timing: final rollup for my forecast goes out 09:30 PT on Thursday (11/26). Please confirm your list by 08:45 PT so I can reconcile.

Why this matters: the finance team needs a high-confidence view for the board deck. We want to avoid last-minute surprise swings; if a large deal is still in negotiation, keep it in "Late Stage" rather than commit.

Example: ACME-1427 (Acme Health) — please confirm if that $450k is being counted as commit.

Thanks — quick replies only, I will consolidate.

--
